dashes.name: Big numbers
dashes.author: TunerLoop
dashes.description: Four readings you pick, as big as the screen allows, in your units. Tap to hide or show the tab bar; the gear picks the readings.

dashes.name: Shift light
dashes.author: TunerLoop
dashes.description: A full-screen shift light: a row of lights that fill with the revs and flash at the shift point, and the best RPM this phone has seen. Tap to hide or show the tab bar.
